selectPrompt.title: Select a skill

drawer.title: Add a skill

file.trustWarning: Importing someone else's skill means their instructions become part of your agent's prompt. Review the body below before enabling it.
file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.descriptionHint: Write this as a directive — it's the skill's interface.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: Author a new reusable skill from scratch

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag any test file that only covers the happy path.
fields.descriptionHint: Write this as a directive — it's the skill's interface, telling an agent exactly when and how to use it.

editor.runOnEvalsHint: Evals arrive in a later lesson.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: Write this as a directive — it's the skill's interface, telling an agent exactly when and how to use it.

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
